suggestions: reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
replace rollup with explicit grouping and joins
optimized_sql:
SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk
FROM (
    SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY sumsales DESC) AS rk
    FROM (
        SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id,
               SUM(f.sumsales) AS sumsales
        FROM (
            SELECT ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_store_sk, dd.d_year, dd.d_qoy, dd.d_moy,
                   COALESCE(SUM(ss.ss_sales_price * ss.ss_quantity), 0) AS sumsales
            FROM store_sales AS ss
            JOIN date_dim AS dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
            WHERE dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217 + 11
            GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_store_sk, dd.d_year, dd.d_qoy, dd.d_moy
        ) AS f
        JOIN item AS i ON f.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN store AS s ON f.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
        GROUP BY ROLLUP(i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id)
    ) AS rolled
) AS ranked
WHERE rk <= 100
ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk
LIMIT 100

reasoning_trace:
1. DATE-WINDOW PUSHDOWN — TARGET: `store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk` + `date_dim.d_month_seq` — TRANSFORMATION: Restrict `store_sales` to only the 12-month `d_date_sk` set (`d_month_seq` 1217–1228) before any other join/aggregation, so the huge fact scan/aggregate sees far fewer rows.

2. FACT PRE-AGGREGATION — TARGET: filtered `store_sales` before joining `item`/`store` and before `GROUP BY ROLLUP` — TRANSFORMATION: First aggregate the filtered fact rows by `ss_item_sk, ss_store_sk, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy`, computing `coalesce(sum(ss_sales_price*ss_quantity),0)`, so the later rollup runs on a compressed relation instead of raw 57.6M-row `store_sales`.

3. ROLLUP ON COMPRESSED INPUT — TARGET: `GROUP BY ROLLUP(i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id)` in `dw1` — TRANSFORMATION: Apply the rollup as a second-stage `GROUP BY` over the pre-aggregated fact result joined to `item` and `store`, making all 256 grouping-set computations operate on the smallest row count.

4. COALESCE PULL-OUT — TARGET: `sum(coalesce(ss_sales_price*ss_quantity,0))` inside the innermost SELECT — TRANSFORMATION: Change to `coalesce(sum(ss_sales_price*ss_quantity),0)`; identical results, but avoids evaluating `COALESCE` on every input row during the fact aggregation.
